**Risk officer call: refuse. Skip DOTF.**

Refuse any size. The brief shows the coin is operator-backed in its most extreme form: 11 buyers ex-agent in the first two minutes absorbed 1,982 SOL, with a top-5 buyer share of 99.98%, a bundle share of 1.0, and a sell-to-buy ratio of 0.0001. That is not a broad launch with a whale. It is a single cluster holding almost everything, and the 2,107 SOL pool depth means that cluster can exit at will, against a very thin float of real sellers.

The last-15-minute data doesn't offset this. A 1.85% return on $5.4k volume, with 16 sellers against 46 buyers, reads as the operator's book being managed, not as organic demand. Top-3 share at 1.0 and completer share near 2.87 point the same way.

If the desk ever revisits, the minimum bar would be a visibly distributed holder base, a sell-to-buy ratio that is not near zero, and a top-5 buyer share well below 0.5. None of those are present. Skip.

But the rest of the brief points the other way. The first two minutes after graduation show 1,982 SOL bought by 11 buyers, with the top five buyers taking 99.98% of volume and a launch bot present. Bundled curve buying of this kind is a concentrated operator footprint, not organic demand, and the 46 recent buyers are small against the sheer size of that early position. Most likely loss: an insider or bundle exit. The curve is 100% bundle-controlled (bundle_share 1.0, top3_share 1.0), and the first two minutes after graduation show 1,982 SOL of buys from only 11 outside buyers, with a launch bot present and top-5 buyers holding 99.98% of that flow. The creator and launch wallets hold the bulk of supply, so a single sell can crater the pool. The pool depth is 2,108 SOL, so a large exit would move price far more than our 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost.

The last 15 minutes look like recycled flow, not organic demand: 46 buyers against 16 sellers, but the sell-to-buy ratio near launch is 0.0001, meaning almost no one outside the operator sold early. A 1.85% gain is smaller than fees and impact, so even a small move up doesn't pay. Skip.
